projects.name: MiniLang Optimizing Compiler
projects.summary: An optimizing compiler for a statically-typed toy language, targeting x86-64 assembly.
key_features: LALR(1) parser with detailed syntax error recovery
SSA-based intermediate representation with constant folding and dead code elimination

projects.name: RaftKV Distributed Key-Value Store
projects.summary: A fault-tolerant, linearizable distributed key-value store built on the Raft consensus algorithm.
key_features: Leader election, randomized heartbeat timers, and dynamic membership reconfiguration
Log compaction with asynchronous memory snapshotting to disk
Linearizable read-index lease queries avoiding stale reads

projects.name: Neural Semantic Code Search Engine
projects.summary: A semantic code search engine that maps natural language queries to AST embeddings for high-accuracy code retrieval.
key_features: Polyglot AST parsing for Rust, Go, and Python using Tree-sitter
Contrastive bi-encoder embeddings trained on code-docstring pairs
Sub-15ms vector retrieval using quantized FAISS indexes
